如果目标分支不是 %@，请替换为实际发布分支。: If the target branch is not %@, replace it with the actual publishing branch.
当前分支未设置 upstream；可以本地写入，但 PR/MR 和远端差异判断前: The current branch has no upstream. You can still write locally, but confirm the remote before creating a PR/MR or evaluating remote differences.
如果远端或分支名不同，请先用 git remote -v 和 git branc: If the remote or branch names differ, verify them first with git remote -v and git branch -vv.
本地领先 %@，落后 %@；发布前先同步远端，避免覆盖或漏掉站点变更。: The local branch is %@ ahead and %@ behind. Sync remote changes before publishing to avoid overwriting or missing site changes.
如果 fast-forward 失败，说明需要手动处理分叉后再继续发布。: If fast-forward fails, resolve the branch divergence manually before continuing to publish.
本地分支落后远端 %@ 个提交；发布前建议先拉取最新站点内容。: The local branch is %@ commits behind the remote. Pull the latest site content before publishing.

本地领先远端 %@ 个提交；创建新发布前先确认这些提交是否已经准备好推送。: The local branch is %@ commits ahead of the remote. Before creating a new release, confirm that these commits are ready to push.
如果这些提交还需要合并进 PR/MR，请不要直接推送到正式分支。: If these commits still need to be merged through a PR/MR, do not push them directly to the production branch.
当前分支与 upstream 一致，可以继续发布前检查、写入和提交。: The current branch matches its upstream. You can continue with pre-publish checks, writing, and committing.
